name: release-notes
description: Draft a release's changelog entry from the commits since the last tag

interface.shortDescription: Changelog entries ruled from the commits
interface.longDescription: Read every commit since the last tag against its own diff, rule on each one by whether a person running the software can observe it, and write the surviving entries to CHANGELOG.md under a version heading and to $GIT_DIR/RELEASE_EDITMSG for whatever publishes the release. The ruling is shown per commit before anything is written, so a change that was left out is visible rather than silently missing.
capabilities: Rule on every commit in a release against one test
Flag where a commit message and its diff disagree
Write the entry to CHANGELOG.md and to the release body file
defaultPrompt: What changed since the last release?
Write the release notes for this version.
